headline_marked: Amazon stops accepting new customers for [[Mechanical Turk]] on July 30
headline: Amazon stops accepting new customers for Mechanical Turk on July 30
summary: Amazon's crowdsourcing service to close to new customers. Existing customers can continue using the service as normal.
details: Amazon announced that Mechanical Turk will stop accepting new customers on July 30, 2026. The decision was made after 'careful consideration', according to Amazon Web Services.

Mechanical Turk, launched in 2005, was a marketplace where people were paid to perform simple tasks that resisted full automation. The service played a role in debates around the ethics of crowdsourced labor and the Facebook-Cambridge Analytica scandal.

The platform was also used for companies to annotate data to train neural networks as part of Amazon's SageMaker AI service. A 2023 analysis found that 33-46% of workers on the platform used large language models to complete tasks.
caption:
